product.name: KALLBODA dishwasher
product.introText: Integrated dishwasher, IKEA 700, 60 cm, with cutlery drawer. Keys on the top edge of the door, Time Beam on the floor. Manual AA-2576614 (simplified: basic settings, basket heights and water-hardness setting are not simulated). Programmes run at 90x speed.

help: Click the door handle, the baskets, the dispenser, the caps and the keys on the top edge of the door Right-drag orbit Wheel zoom

tasks.title: Open the door
tasks.text: Click the door handle: the door folds down to 90°.

tasks.title: Pull out the lower basket
tasks.text: Click the lower basket to slide it out.

tasks.title: Refill special salt
tasks.text: Click the salt reservoir cap in the cabinet floor (only reachable with the lower basket out).

tasks.title: Load the lower basket
tasks.text: Click the lower basket again to load plates, then once more to push it in.

tasks.title: Load the upper basket
tasks.text: Click the upper basket: out, load cups, push in.

tasks.title: Refill rinse aid
tasks.text: Click the rinse-aid cap next to the dispenser on the door.

tasks.title: Add detergent
tasks.text: Click the dispenser to open it, click again to put in a tablet and close the lid.

tasks.title: Switch on
tasks.text: Press I/O on the top edge of the door.

tasks.title: Half Load
tasks.text: Press 1/2 - shorter cycle and less detergent for a half-full machine.

tasks.title: Start and close the door
tasks.text: Press START, then close the door within 4 seconds.

tasks.title: Wait for the end
tasks.text: Time Beam on the floor shows the remaining time; the programme runs at 90x speed (~2 min).

tasks.title: Open and switch off
tasks.text: Open the door and press I/O.
